name: skullmaster-retrieval-eval
description: Deterministic RAG benchmark corpus. Fictional 'Meridian Program' documents with distractor material; questions cover the ten required retrieval scenarios. Expected fields: relevant (source keys that should be retrieved), match ('all'|'any'), expected_page (grounding check), expected_facts (substrings a grounded answer should contain), must_not (substrings that indicate an unsupported/hallucinated claim), expected_refusal (true when the closed-world answer must decline), citation_required (source keys a complete answer should cite).

pages.text: The Atlas Operations Charter establishes the Meridian Program. The program's primary objective is to deploy a regional sensor network across the Atacama Desert by the third quarter. The charter was ratified on March 12.
Section 4: Budget. The total approved budget for the Meridian Program is 940 million dollars. Annual operating costs are capped at 12 million dollars.
Section 7: Governance. The program director reports to the Chief Operating Officer. Governance reviews occur quarterly.

documents.name: records_retention_policy.txt
documents.text: Records retention policy: laboratory notebooks are archived for seven years. Personal journals may be discarded after two years. Archive requests go to the facilities desk.

pages.text: Laboratory safety handbook. Eye protection is mandatory in the wet lab. Gloves must be nitrile, not latex. Spill kits are stored beside every bench.
Emergency procedures: assemble at the north stairwell. Do not use the elevators during a drill. Report injuries to the safety officer.
